title: I-Bahn (Index U-Bahn) (ft. 72kchunshuai)
author: cyddrdrd
rules:
This puzzle is created by 72kchunshuai and rdrd. It was a real pleasure working with him, and we're both very happy with how our puzzle turned out! He is a great setter, and I'd definitely recommend checking out his puzzles, especially everything since Whispering Chaos (according to him, at least :D)!

Rules

• Sudoku: Fill the grid with digits 1-9, so that no digit repeats in the same row, column, or 3×3 box.

• U-Bahn: Draw a totally connected network through the centers of some cells in the grid. The network may branch or turn, but may not have any dead ends. Clues outside the grid indicate how many times the corresponding line shape (cross, branch, straight line, or turn) appears in that row/column, regardless of rotation.

• Index lines: Box borders divide the network into index lines that are not allowed to branch, touch themselves, or form loops.
The digit in position N along an index line indicates which position along the line has a digit N. Counting starts from either end of the line (to be deduced by the solver) which is position 1. Eg: if position 2 has a digit 4, then position 4 would have a digit 2.

Thank you Christounet, Piatato and Dylan for testing and suggestions!
